current_focus.domain: public Payments repository and provider topology
current_focus.summary: Create the public dinkuskit/payments repository and reserve @dinkuskit/payments with EmDash plugin ID dinkus-payments. Document that Commerce owns authoritative amount, checkout, attempt, order, receipt, and the provider port; Payments owns server-side provider selection, processor adapters, Stripe transport, webhook verification, and normalized results. Allow exactly one active provider per store, implement only Stripe for the demo, reject unknown providers with no fallback or browser selection, allow USD only using integer minor units plus currency, and defer other currencies. The initial source is a verified non-operational scaffold with no Stripe SDK, credentials, live payment calls, publishing, deployment, Commerce changes, template-store changes, inventory changes, or shipping work.

decisions.choice: Ship one @dinkuskit/payments EmDash plugin with a server-owned adapter registry and exactly one active provider per store. Stripe is the only implemented and supported demo provider. Future processors may be isolated adapters behind the Commerce-owned provider contract; unknown providers fail closed, with no fallback or browser selection.
